Explosions Reported on Iran's Qeshm Island

Several loud explosions were heard on Iran's strategic Qeshm island, with the sounds reportedly originating from the direction of the sea. Local sources and official media confirmed the sounds, which have increased activity and concern in the area. The explosions were heard on Qeshm island, located in the Persian Gulf.
